layers.note: A tree to 10 m along washes and where deep water lies, in the open subcanopy.

moisture.note: Washes, floodplains and flats over deep groundwater.

moisture_index.note: Arid to semi-arid; it reaches groundwater.

summer_rain.note: Both rain regimes; it draws on groundwater.

provenance.notes: Velvet mesquite. A desert niche of plant forms F8's first placement (2026-10-07): authored from general knowledge of the species in the Sonoran Desert and checked against the Saguaro National Park places' CHELSA V2.1 climate (bajada 752 m, rocky hills 1,096 m), not yet against the public-domain FEIS reviews or fitted to occurrence records; the fit to GBIF occurrences over CHELSA comes with PlantGen (F8 in docs/roadmaps/PLANTS.md). Only the climate and site ranges niches have today: no soil, wash, spacing or nurse rules yet.
